import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    qtty = data[0]
    shts = data[1:1+qtty]
    ts = data[1+qtty]
    shts.sort()
    maxspan = 0
    window = deque()
    n = len(shts)
    for r in range(n):
        while window and shts[r] - shts[window[0]] > ts:
            window.popleft()
        window.append(r)
        cur = r - window[0] + 1
        if cur > maxspan:
            maxspan = cur
    print(maxspan)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
